messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for az2-control-plane-high-error-rate — PD incident #PD-4821. Automatic page to oncall: Kevin. Root metrics: control-plane 5xx spike, connection drops to model shards in az2.

pagerduty: Page PD-4821 -> oncall-kevin (escalation policy: control-plane-high). Pager duty log: page fired 1m ago, no ack yet.

oncall-kevin: ack — looking now. pinging infra and runtime. Any customer-facing impact?

maria: seeing burst of 502s in frontend metrics for eu-west routes that prefer az2. Map: ~9% of requests failing with 502s, latency up 180ms p50->p75.

lee: K8s healthchecks show repeated Pod restarts on az2-runtime-0{4..6}. Node telemetry shows NIC errors + kernel complaints about XDP.

sam: checking autoscaler — AZ weight shows az2 capacity still high but pod evictions happened. Might be soft NIC flaps not full node loss.

anya: from customer side, we have a few enterprise customers with dedicated capacity in az2. Flagging for potential SLA impact. I'll pull the customer list and notif.

oncall-kevin: timeline and immediate plan: 1) ack/confirm, 2) try rolling restart of az2 runtime pods with --grace 30s, 3) if persistence issues continue, flip routing policy to route-new-requests to az3 fallback. Anyone object?

eng-runtime: no objections. Recommend we enable routing fallback for affected model-shards first, not all traffic — do canary reroute 10% -> az3 then 50%. That preserves state for dedicated customers.

maria: running quick query: affected model endpoints include /generate/v1 and /embed/v2 for specific shard groups. Traffic impact concentrated on customers with regional pinning.

incident-bot: PD update: PD-4821 escalated to level-2 oncall after 8m without mitigation.

oncall-kevin: executing rolling restart now on az2-runtime-004..006. Running: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/runtime-az2 --namespace=redwood-runtime` — will monitor logs.

sam: I'm also initiating a control-plane scaling event: adding 2 standby nodes to az2 pool to see if that absorbs state churn.

lee: getting kernel Oops on az2-runtime-005 during restart cycles, looks like NIC firmware handshake timeout. Bad batch of nodes.

anya: opened a customer-impact ticket and posting to the Customer Success channel. Notifying three enterprise accounts (AcmeCorp, ByteScale, Fundly) — sharing mitigation steps and ETA 30m for reroute.

maria: quick impact estimate: 9% total request failure, but for pinned customers it's 40-60% across their routed endpoints. Flagging as partial outage for those tenants.

oncall-kevin: decision: activate region fallback policy for control-plane routes in az2. Steps: 1) mark az2 as degraded in router, 2) start canary 10% -> az3, 3) watch errors/latency for 10m, 4) increase to 50% if stable. Eng-runtime to run canary.

eng-runtime: running canary: `routerctl set-weight --pool=az2-control --fallback=az3-control --weight=90/10` — canary started. Monitoring traces now.

maria: after canary: client errors drop to 2% on canary traffic, latency stable. No immediate regression.

incident-bot: PD update: PD-4821 acknowledged by oncall-kevin and assigned to SRE team.

oncall-kevin: ramping to 50% now. Will coordinate with infra to isolate bad nodes. Sam — can you cordon az2-runtime-005 and drain it?

sam: cordon+drain in progress: `kubectl cordon az2-runtime-005 && kubectl drain az2-runtime-005 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` — pods moving off.

lee: NIC vendor confirmed known firmware issue on this kernel combination. They're sending guidance; ops recommends reboot+firmware update for suspect nodes.

anya: drafting customer update: short note that we detected az2 networking instability affecting a subset of customers, we've routed traffic to fallback region and are remediate nodes — will provide update in 45m.

oncall-kevin: good. Also disabling scheduled deploys to az2 for next 2h: `deployctl freeze --region=az2 --duration=2h`.

maria: monitoring shows errors down to baseline for 50% routed traffic. Overall failures back to ~1.2%. For affected pinned tenants, still seeing intermittent 5xx while nodes drain.

sam: nodes drained and placed into maintenance pool. Starting firmware update on 3 nodes now.

eng-runtime: confirming routing fallback increased to 80/20 to limit customer impact while node remediation proceeds.

incident-bot: PD update: PD-4821 status -> mitigated (routing fallback active, node remediation ongoing). Auto-reminder set for 1h to review progress.

oncall-kevin: we're keeping incident channel open until all firmware patches complete and az2 is back to normal. Action items: Sam - finish firmware + bring nodes back healthy; Lee - validate kernel logs; Maria - continue customer comms; Anya - update CS follow-ups.

anya: will post update to CS with list of impacted accounts and timeline.

maria: also capturing incident metrics for postmortem: error spike start 3109876520, mitigation (canary) started 3109876612, full fallback to 50% by 3109876660.

lee: node health trending good after firmware; reboot sequence completed on 3 nodes, kernel oops absent for 20m.

sam: bringing nodes back into rotation one at a time. Will coordinate with eng-runtime for weight adjustments.

oncall-kevin: when last node back, we will reverse routing fallback gradually 20% steps and watch for regression. No rollbacks until 30m stable.

incident-bot: PD-4821 auto-note: followup postmortem required. Please assign runbook owner within 24h.

maria: assigning postmortem owner: Lee — will collect logs, timeline, and customer impact.

anya: CS update posted. Customers acknowledged and appreciated the quick routing mitigation.

eng-runtime: confirm final state: az2 marked degraded until end of maintenance window; fallback routing remains at 20% while we finish validation.

oncall-kevin: thanks all. keep channel updated with any regression. I'll handoff to next oncall in 40m — @oncall-kevin -> @oncall-sam for followup.

sam: ack taking followup handoff. continuing node remediation and will post final status. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: channel note: thread closed by oncall-sam after stabilization. PD-4821 resolved status -> closed pending postmortem.
